mapper.select: SELECT id, barcode, name_chinese, name_foreign, supplier_name, inventory_qty, remark, status, created_at, updated_at FROM replenish_records WHERE status = N'pending' ORDER BY supplier_name ASC, created_at ASC, id ASC
SELECT id, barcode, name_chinese, name_foreign, supplier_name, inventory_qty, remark, status, created_at, updated_at FROM replenish_records WHERE status = N'done' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
